coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 2 of 6 ground-truth variable categories (33%): the comparison of original-attention SiT with non-causal Hyena SiT, and comparison of generated versus reference autocorrelation functions, although the latter is only a broad match.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Replaces the specified pentapeptide MDGEN dataset (100k-frame, 10 ns trajectories) with unrelated benchmarks and invents training settings rather than following Tables 2 and 4. Omits the 100 fs–100 ps lag-time range, does not specify torsional autocorrelation against MD data, and omits dynamical content defined as the negative derivative of autocorrelation with respect to log-timescale. Adds numerous unsupported metrics, ablations, and decision thresholds.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Missing the conclusion that Hyena-augmented SiT generates extremely long, physically plausible molecular trajectories matching MD autocorrelation across timescales and capturing both fast oscillatory and slow relaxation features.
